lore.Noctis City: A cikin zurfin Noctis Labyrinthus, bangon kwazazzabo masu tsayin kilomita suna kare su daga hasken sararin samaniya, mazauna na farko sun sami wuri mafi dacewa don birni.
lore.Tharsis Tholus: Tsohon dutsen wuta mai siffar garkuwa wanda kansa ya rushe. Ramukan lava nasa su ne mafakar farko ta ƙungiyoyin binciken Tharsis, kuma har yanzu suna ƙara da fanka masu hura iska.
lore.Ascraeus Mons: Mafi arewa cikin ƙattai uku na Tharsis, tsayin kilomita 18. A kan ramin kansa ne aka auna lif na farko na falaki aka kuma watsar da shi.
lore.Pavonis Mons: Yana kusan daidai a kan layin ekweta, "Dutsen Ɗawisu" shi ne anga na halitta ga lif na sararin samaniya; fitilun bincike a gefensa har yanzu suna ƙyalƙyali.
lore.Arsia Mons: Dutsen wuta na kudu na Tharsis, gajimaren safe sun lulluɓe shi. Ramin kansa yana ɓoye mafi tsofaffin tarin ƙanƙara a yankin, ana ta rigima a kansu tun takardar farko ta haƙƙin ruwa.
lore.Ganymede Colony: Wata mafi girma na Jupiter, ya fi Mercury girma. Mulkin mallakar yana kan ƙasa mai haske mai layuka, yana musayar ƙanƙarar ruwa da haƙuri da tsarin cikin.
lore.Phobos Space Haven: Watan ciki na Mars, yana shawagi kilomita 6,000 sama da ƙasa. Ramin Stickney da aka haƙe ya zama tashar jiragen ruwa mafi cunkoso tsakanin Mars da ɗamarar taurari.
lore.Elysium Mons: Babban dutsen wuta na gabas, tsayin kilomita 12 kuma shiru na 'yan miliyoyin shekaru. Masu bincike sun rantse cewa kansa ya fi zafi fiye da yadda ya kamata; ƙungiyar makamashin ƙasa ta ƙi yin tsokaci cikin ladabi.
lore.Hecates Tholus: An sa masa sunan allahiyar mararraba da dare. Tsofaffin kankarar ƙasa sun sassaƙa gefensa, kuma masu haƙar ƙanƙara da ke aiki a can suna barin fitila tana ci a bakin rami don sa'a.
lore.Olympus Mons: Dutsen wuta mafi tsayi a tsarin rana: tsayin kilomita 22 kuma faɗinsa kamar Faransa. Daga ƙoli sararin sama yana da nisa sosai har ba za ka gane kana kan dutse ba. Duk da haka kallon ya cancanci tafiyar makonni uku.
lore.South Pole: Layi bisa layi na ƙanƙarar ruwa ƙarƙashin hular busasshiyar ƙanƙara ta lokaci. Kowace bazara CO₂ yana tururi cikin maɓuɓɓugan duhu da mazauna suke kira "gizo-gizo" kuma masu yawon buɗe ido suna biyan kuɗi mai kyau don kallo.
lore.Alba Mons: Dutsen wuta mafi faɗi a Mars, ya bazu fiye da kilomita 1,000 amma tsayinsa kilomita 7 kawai. Dutsen da za ka hau ba tare da ka lura ba, abin da Ƙungiyar Masu Tafiya a Tuddan Alba ke ɗauka a matsayin abin alfahari.
lore.Uranius Tholus: Ƙaramin dutsen wuta mai tsauri a inuwar babban ɗan'uwansa Uranius Mons. An ɗaure tashar yanayi ta atomatik ta farko ta filayen arewa a ƙolinsa, kuma har yanzu tana aika hasashe kowace sa'a: ƙura.
lore.Viking 1: Wurin da Viking 1 ya sauka, jirgi na farko da ya yi aiki a saman Mars (1976). An kewaye jirgin da shinge a matsayin wurin gado, kuma ana sa ran kowane sabon mazauni ya bar ɗan dutse ɗaya a ƙofa.
lore.Viking 2: Inda Viking 2 ya sauka a Utopia Planitia a 1976 ya kuma ɗauki hoton raɓa mai daskarewa a kan duwatsu. Matsugunin ya girma a kewayen jirgin, kuma yanzu ana bikin raɓar kowane damina da bikin miya mai sanyi sosai.
lore.North Pole: Hular ƙanƙarar ruwa mai kauri kusan kilomita 3, iska ta sassaƙa mata kwazazzabai masu karkace. Injiniyoyin teku suna kiranta "tafki", kuma da gaske suke.

Taswira
Taɓa ko yi shawagi a kan wuri don cikakkun bayanai · ƙafa / matse yatsu don zuƙowa · ja don motsawa bayan zuƙowa · danna sau biyu (ko H) don ganin dukan allo.

menu.autoTitle: Bari TFMBot ya yanke shawararka ta yanzu
menu.fine: Injin dokoki: tfmc (C → WebAssembly) a cikin burauzarka. TFMBot: zakaran da ake amfani da shi, yana gudana kai tsaye a kan sabar. Ba shi da alaƙa da FryxGames, Asmodee Digital ko Steam.
help.title: Yadda ake wasa a nan
help.globe:
Duniya
Ja don juyawa · ƙafa / matse yatsu don zuƙowa · yatsu biyu ko jan dama don motsawa · danna sau biyu (ko H) don komawa tsakiya.
help.turn:
Juyinka
Katunan da ke haske a hannunka ana iya buga su — danna ɗaya don karanta shi ka buga. Ayyukan asali, ayyukan katuna, matakai da kyaututtuka suna gefen dama.
help.tiles:
Sanya yankuna
Wuraren da za a iya zaɓa suna haske da launin zinariya. Yi shawagi don ganin yankin kafin a sanya da abin da wurin zai ba ka.
help.undo:
Koma baya
Koma baya a kan komai har sai an bayyana kati. Idan juyinka ya ƙare za ka ga Tabbatar da juyi — babu abin da zai kai ga TFMBot har sai ka tabbatar. Ctrl+Z koma baya · Enter tabbatar · Esc soke.
help.opp:
Abokin karawa
Yi shawagi (ko riƙe) a kan allon ɗan wasa don ganin katunansa na tebur. Jerin da ke hagu yana nuna kowane motsin TFMBot da abin da ya yi la'akari da shi; sandar sama tana nuna ƙiyasinsa na damarka ta nasara.
help.tracks:
Ma'auni
Zafin jiki: kyautar samar da zafi a −24 da −20, teku a 0 °C. Iskar oxygen: +1 zafin jiki a 8%. Tekuna: wurare 9.
help.hint:
💡 Alama
Tana tambayar TFMBot abin da zai buga a matsayinka, tare da rabon bincike na mafi kyawun zaɓuɓɓukansa.
